units.source_text: 吟声非常轻微，半吞半吐，断断续续地说出。

en.t: Her reciting voice was very faint, and the words came out half-swallowed, halting and broken.

units.source_text: 这态度也非常肖似大女公子，就已使薰中纳言悲伤不堪了。

en.t: This manner, too, was very much like the elder princess, and it was already more grief than Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, could bear.
